description: A valid spacing scale has a parseable base unit, at least 4 distinct named steps, semantic role coverage, and no sub-2px values.

rules.description: A spacing scale needs at least 4 steps to express the range from tight (4px) to loose (32px+). Fewer steps produce a system with insufficient density control.
Every step must have an id or name so it can be referenced by semantic roles and downstream compilers. Anonymous steps are unreferable.
Every step must declare a value so contrast, multiple, and min-spacing gates can evaluate it.
The baseUnit must be a parseable pixel value (e.g. '4px', '8', '0.5rem'). Unparseable base units make the multiple-check gate unable to verify step relationships.
